summary: Arc System Works' anime fighting series, covering the main games, major definitive revisions, and notable standalone spinoffs.

entries.title: Guilty Gear

primary.why: The original Guilty Gear later received Switch, PS4, and Windows ports for its 20th anniversary; Windows is the highest-fidelity current route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original PlayStation remains the launch-context route.

emulation.notes: Use Dreamcast emulation if not using PC.

primary.why: Guilty Gear X reached arcade, Dreamcast, PS2, Windows, and GBA; the Dreamcast/Plus-era route is the strongest original-generation version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Dreamcast version with Flycast/Redream, or the PC version where compatible.

primary.why: Petit is a WonderSwan Color standalone spinoff; original hardware or WonderSwan emulation is the only route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Guilty Gear Petit on WonderSwan Color hardware or compatible emulator.

primary.why: Petit 2 is a WonderSwan Color standalone sequel; original hardware or WonderSwan emulation is the only route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Guilty Gear Petit 2 on WonderSwan Color hardware or compatible emulator.

entries.title: Guilty Gear X2
entries.definitive_edition: Guilty Gear XX Accent Core Plus R

primary.version: Guilty Gear XX Accent Core Plus R
primary.why: Accent Core Plus R is the final major Guilty Gear XX revision, with later PC/Switch releases and rollback netcode on Steam.
primary.how_to_play: Play Guilty Gear XX Accent Core Plus R on Windows/Steam.

entries.remaster_caveats: Earlier XX versions are historical balance snapshots.

primary.why: Isuka is a standalone four-player/side-switching spinoff that reached PC, giving it the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Guilty Gear Isuka on Windows/Steam.

emulation.notes: Use DS emulation with suitable screen layout.

primary.why: Dust Strikers is a Nintendo DS-only spinoff; DS hardware or emulation is the only route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Guilty Gear Dust Strikers on Nintendo DS hardware or melonDS/DeSmuME.

emulation.notes: Use PSP emulation with increased internal resolution.

primary.why: Judgment is a PSP beat-'em-up spinoff bundled with a PSP version of Guilty Gear XX; PSP emulation gives the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Guilty Gear Judgment with PPSSPP at increased internal resolution.

entries.title: Guilty Gear 2: Overture

primary.why: Overture is a 3D action/strategy sequel that later came to Steam; Windows is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Guilty Gear 2: Overture on Windows/Steam.

entries.remaster_caveats: Different genre from the core fighting entries.

entries.title: Guilty Gear Xrd

primary.why: Rev 2 is the final major Xrd revision and is available on Steam; Windows is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Guilty Gear Xrd Rev 2 on Windows/Steam.

entries.remaster_caveats: Xrd -Sign- and Revelator are earlier story/balance snapshots.

primary.version: PC release with current season updates
primary.why: Strive is available on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, arcade, and Switch; Windows offers the highest-fidelity route with crossplay across PS/Steam/Xbox/Windows but not Switch/arcade.
primary.how_to_play: Play Guilty Gear Strive on Windows/Steam with current patches and desired season passes.
